nodes.label: v3 FOV Previews README (Depth Pro profiler)
v3 Depth Pro Profiler (true-meters + FOV modifier)
nodes.rationale: v3 classifies shots in TRUE metric meters (close <3m / wide >11m) with per-shot mean horizontal FOV as a modifier (long lens <30 deg biases close-up, wide lens >60 deg biases wide). Depth Pro runs only as a 3-keyframe-per-shot profiler; VDA stays the main depth pass. Device verdict: v3 > v2 because classification accuracy at the source improved (long-lens close-ups correctly called close_up past the 3m metric cut); auto_comfort was a no-op since v3 already lands disparities in-budget.

nodes.label: Silent-Hang Heartbeat Watchdog
nodes.rationale: A letterbox depth job (9d759002879a) hung silently ~94 min with no progress and had to be cancelled/resubmitted; this motivated the ShotProfiler decouple (branch profiler-decouple) and a heartbeat-watchdog follow-up that cancels workers after no progress (later batch failures show 'no worker progress for 600s (silent hang) - cancelled and failed; resubmit').
